# Repair Request for Kitchen Faucet and Bathroom Fan

A professional, calm note that clearly asks for timely repairs while keeping the tone firm and respectful. It reflects the 3-week delay and your month-to-month tenancy without sounding aggressive.

## Email Draft and Follow-Up Message

**Subject:** Request for Prompt Repairs in Apartment

Dear [Landlord’s Name],

I hope you are doing well. I am writing to request repairs for two issues in my apartment that have been ongoing for the past three weeks: a leaking kitchen faucet and a broken bathroom fan.

The leak is causing ongoing inconvenience, and the bathroom fan is no longer functioning properly, which is affecting ventilation in the unit. Since these issues have not yet been resolved, I would appreciate it if they could be addressed as soon as possible.

Please let me know when I can expect a repair visit or if you need any additional information from me. I would appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.

Thank you for your time and assistance.

Sincerely,
[Your Full Name]
[Apartment Number]
[Phone Number]
[Email Address]

### Follow-Up After 7 Days

Dear [Landlord’s Name],

I am following up on my earlier message regarding the leaking kitchen faucet and broken bathroom fan in my apartment. These issues have now been ongoing for more than three weeks, and I have not yet received an update.

I would appreciate confirmation of when the repairs will be scheduled. Please let me know at your earliest convenience.

Thank you,
[Your Full Name]
